summary: Garden Stage Ltd filed a Form 6-K to correct inadvertent errors on cover pages of prior prospectus supplements, updating disclosure of securities sold under General Instruction I.B.5 of Form F-3 and public float calculations. No new transaction, offer, or corporate action is announced. This is a routine administrative correction to existing registration statements, not a special-situation event. As a foreign private issuer, this Form 6-K is equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K for reporting material events, but here it solely corrects prior disclosure. No deal terms, stakeholder actions, or strategic changes are described.
